text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it has maintained its outperform rating on Brazilian cable television firm Multicanal but raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings per American Depositary Receipt forecast for the firm.
-- "The company should continue to deliver solid earnings and EBITDA growth driven by a strong expansion of the company's cable subscriber base," the brokerage said in a statement.
-- Morgan Stanley said it expects Multicanal government bidding which should add to the firm's upside potential.

-- It was raising its EPS estimate to $0.28 from $0.06 for 1997 and to $.49 from $0.28 for 1998 on "stronger-than-expected 1996 results and our belief that earnings momentum will remain solid over the next several years."
-- It has set a year-end price target of $17 for Multicanal.

-- Multicanal Participacoes' Level One ADR was flat at 14 1/2 at 1547 local/1447 EDT. Neither its common or preferred shares were traded Friday on the Sao Paulo bourse. The preferred closed Monday at 1.55 reais.
